messages:
pagerduty: [P1] PROD - inference-gateway-usw2: 5xx rate 7.8% (1m). Pager fired. incident key: pd_inc_1752468001
incident-bot: Auto-page: pd_inc_1752468001 -> routing to eng-sre oncall @maya
maya: acked. looking.
maya: initial triage: spike from edge-proxy -> several 502s; rate correlates with retries in logs. no full outage but error rate impacting some customers.
sam: any recent deploys to inference-gateway? saw a canary yesterday night but all green.
maya: checking logs+kvcache metrics. running quick query:
```bash
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=edge-proxy --tail=200 | grep "502" | head
``` 
maya: kv cache evictions spiking (oom?), see repeated "kv_cache_miss" and "backend_retry" events.
jordan: tagging support to notify affected customers. ops-lead: what's recommended mitigation from runbook? link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference/5xx
ops-lead: runbook short: 1) divert traffic to west-canary 2) warm kv cache 3) scale edge-proxy 4) rollback last deploy
maya: starting: scale edge-proxy +2 replicas, kicking warm job for kvcache:
```bash
kubectl scale deployment/edge-proxy -n inference --replicas=8
kubectl run kv-warm --image=tools/kv-warm -- /warm --duration=60
``` 
sam: pushing temporary route weight: set weight inference-gateway-usw2 -> 0.6, inference-gateway-canary -> 0.4
maya: updated routing. monitoring error rate.
incident-bot: action recorded: scaled edge-proxy, route update, kv-warm job started.
maya: error rate dropped to 2.1% after scale+warm. still above baseline 0.3% but trending down.
ops-lead: good. if it continues to fall keep monitoring 15m then close. if not, consider rollback.
jordan: support notified customers A, B, C in EU who saw degraded responses today. sending templated note :envelope:
maya: plan: continue watch, prepare rollback PR just in case. leaving oncall for 30 more mins, then handoff to night team if stable.
sam: ack. thx all.
pagerduty: Incident pd_inc_1752468001 acknowledged by maya (eng-sre) at 1752468012
maya: closing? will wait 15m and then mark resolved if stable :thumbsup:
maya: last check (+20m): 5xx rate steady 0.4%. marking resolved.
pagerduty: Incident pd_inc_1752468001 resolved at 1752468125
